page.overview:
Who is 4+ Figure?

4+ Figure belongs to LEGO. 4+ Figures are a variety of minifigures introduced in 2001 for the and Creator themes and were discontinued along with the 4+ theme in 2005.

They are taller and more realistic than normal minifigures, but cannot be taken apart. New two inch tall mini-figures are just the right size for younger builders.

In LEGO, 4+ Figure sits among related figures, places, and turning points that give the entry its encyclopedia trail.
